{{Quote|The first savorium-fed thookahs have already proven effective, as a Krozurbian War Council, fed on thookah-steaks, has turned away from two centuries of war and embraced peace.|[[PDA6]], to [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="Droids 8" />}}
The '''Krozurbian war''' occurred between members of the [[Krozurbian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It lasted for two hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]] until the [[Krozurbian War Council]] embraced peace under the influence of [[Savorium herb|savorium]]-fed [[thookah]] steaks.<ref name="Droids 8" /> These thookahs were supplied by the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Zorneth]], who sold them to a [[Unidentified Krozurbian merchant|Krozurbian merchant]].<ref name="Droids 5">[[Droids (1995) 5|''Droids'' (1995) 5]]</ref>
